conviction_note: abs_move 11% (the 8.3% event-implied move scaled up for a lumpy, retail-heavy name whose last 7 prints have a median |move| of 8.5% and a max of 51%, with the Q4 system-shipment outlook as the swing line) times p_up 45, giving -1.1. That is a modest negative lean: Q3 revenue and bookings likely miss a $4.0-4.4m bar the company never guided to, and the $32m Q4 consensus sits above the company's own 'carryover into 2027' wording. It is held near 50 because about 21% of shares outstanding are short at 5 days to cover, the put skew already pays for the downside, and the stock is down about 45% since the last call. The findings sum to -1.5. The two numbers agree in sign and are scored apart.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus is about $4.0m (Earnings Whispers preview, 2026-11-03, https://finviz.com/news/414157/d-waves-q3-test-can-backlog-and-bookings-steady-a-stock-down-45-ahead-of-q4) to $4.3-4.42m (Chartmill / The Right Trader / Benzinga, https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/QBTS/estimates). EPS consensus is -$0.10 (whisper -$0.16). The company's own guide, from CFO Markovich on the 2026-08-06 call (https://www.webull.com/news/15396548202685440), is Q3 revenue 'up modestly' from Q2's $3.08m. Q4 is to be 'up significantly' and to make up 'the majority of the year's total revenue', with two annealing systems likely shipping in Q4 and 'some carryover revenue related to installation and calibration ... into 2027'. Q4 consensus is about $32.2m and FY2026 about $42.5m (TIKR, 2026-10-20, https://www.tikr.com/blog/d-wave-says-most-of-its-2026-revenue-will-come-in-q4-heres-what-the-stock-needs-to-see). The revenue bar is sourced to two roughly agreeing estimate sets plus a qualitative company guide. A 'modest' rise from $3.08m implies about $3.3-3.8m, about 15% under the bar.
positioning_check: Short interest is 79.11m shares as of 2026-10-15 settlement, 5.0 days to cover on 15.83m average volume, against 368.84m shares outstanding (about 21% of shares outstanding, likely more of float) (https://massive.com/quote/qbts, read 2026-11-09). The prior reading was 70.89m shares at 4.2 days to cover on 2026-09-30, so the short was building into the print. This is a crowded short. The sealed skew is +7.61 vol points (25d put over call: downside paid). Put/call open interest is 0.52. The 5-day run-up is +13.95% (largely the +17% IonQ sympathy day on 2026-11-06, with no D-Wave news); the 20-day run-up is -16.32%. The stock is 64% off its 52-week high. Earnings Whispers puts bearish sentiment at 31.0%, up from 22.5%.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue is set up to miss consensus while landing inside the company's own guide. Management guided Q3 'up modestly' from Q2's $3.08m, which implies about $3.3-3.8m, while consensus sits at $4.0-4.42m, a 30-43% sequential rise the company never guided to. This would be the third straight revenue miss (Q1 $2.86m vs $4.31m, Q2 $3.08m vs $4.03m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 revenue miss (2026-08-06) moved -9.28% and the Q1 miss (2026-05-12) moved -6.99%. Both misses were sold, though both prints also carried weak bookings (Q2 $2.1m).
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus has not converged to the guide. If the market had priced the guided number, estimates would sit near $3.5m rather than $4.0-4.4m. It is partly priced, though: the guide has been public for three months, and the stock is down about 45% since the call.
findings.independence: The bar comes from separate documents: Earnings Whispers at $4.0m (https://finviz.com/news/414157/d-waves-q3-test-can-backlog-and-bookings-steady-a-stock-down-45-ahead-of-q4) and Chartmill at $4.42m (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/QBTS/estimates). The guide is a single company document.

findings.finding: Q4 consensus (about $32.2m, FY about $42.5m) assumes nearly full recognition of both annealing systems in Q4. On the Q2 call, however, the CFO said installation and calibration revenue would carry over into 2027, timing is 'a function of site selection', and the only named buyer is FAU ($20m). TIKR notes that a Q4 near $10m would still meet the company's guide while missing consensus by about two-thirds. A reiterated or reset Q4 outlook from a first-time acting CFO is the line this print most likely trades on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 'revenue weighted to Q4' outlook given 2026-08-06 coincided with a -9.28% day. The 2025-05-08 print, which carried a system-sale recognition, moved +51%. System-revenue timing has driven the largest moves in both directions.
findings.why_not_priced: Sell-side Q4 and FY numbers were still at $32m / $42.5m on 2026-10-20 despite the carryover language, so estimates have not been cut to the company's wording. If the market had priced a reset, consensus would sit near $15-20m. The 45% drawdown and the put skew show that part of the risk is in the price.
findings.independence: The carryover quote comes from the call transcript (https://www.webull.com/news/15396548202685440), a separate document from the consensus source. FAU has published nothing on the system's arrival (searched).

findings.finding: No new system sale or dollar-valued customer contract was announced between July and early November 2026. The only items found are the CHIPS funding agreement (not a customer order) and delivery to Como of a 2025 QCaaS deal. This points to another thin bookings quarter after Q2's $2.1m, against management's stated rate of 2-3 system deals a year, with only FAU booked in 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 bookings of $2.1m (after Q1's FAU-driven quarter) were part of the -9.28% reaction on 2026-08-06.
findings.why_not_priced: Previews name bookings as the test, but no estimate exists for them, so a second thin quarter is not in any consensus figure. D-Wave has announced deals with the print before (the January deals), so absence from the 8-K record is an inference, not a number.
findings.independence: The 8-K item list for Aug-Nov 2026 shows only 7.01 business updates, the 9/8 CHIPS 1.01 and officer changes (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001907982.json). The Earnings Whispers preview names bookings as the swing item (https://finviz.com/news/414157/d-waves-q3-test-can-backlog-and-bookings-steady-a-stock-down-45-ahead-of-q4). This is a proxy from absence, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: D-Wave delivered an Advantage2 system to Villa Saporiti, Como (Swiss Quantum Technology: €10m, 50% of capacity for 5 years, option to buy) on 2026-10-15 and inaugurated it on 10-16. This is physical evidence that the company is shipping annealing systems in Q4 as guided. Whether it counts as one of the two Q4 'system ships' or as QCaaS revenue is not disclosed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No separate reaction is recorded. System deliveries have backed the largest up-moves (2025-05-08 +51%).
findings.why_not_priced: The stock fell through mid-October (IonQ offering, lawsuit) while this delivery landed. If it were read as Q4 revenue support, the Q4 skepticism in previews would mention it, and none does. It is QCaaS-structured, though, so the revenue size is unclear.
findings.independence: Confirmed by DCD (https://datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/d-wave-delivers-advantage2-quantum-computer-to-italy). The original SQT deal terms are on the company newsroom (https://www.dwavequantum.com/company/newsroom/press-release/swiss-quantum-technology-sa-signs-10m-agreement-to-deploy-d-wave-advantage2-annealing-quantum-computer/).

findings.finding: The +14% five-day run-up into the print is sympathy, not company news. QBTS rose 17% on 2026-11-06 after IonQ's Q3 beat-and-raise (revenue $173.8m, FY guide raised to $505-515m), and TIKR notes D-Wave had no news of its own. That lifts the bar D-Wave's own numbers must clear on the day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not observed directly on this name's print days.
findings.why_not_priced: The sympathy move is itself the price. The finding is that it was bought on a peer's numbers, which D-Wave's revenue scale ($3m a quarter) cannot echo. This is an inference, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: IonQ's 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001824920/000119312526449779/ionq-ex99_1.htm) confirms the peer print. The sealed baseline's run_up_5d_pct of +13.95% confirms the move.

findings.finding: Short interest built from 70.89m shares (2026-09-30, 4.2 days to cover) to 79.11m (2026-10-15, 5.0 days to cover), about 21% of 368.8m shares outstanding. That is a crowded short into a print where any confirmation of Q4 shipments or a bookings rebound has a squeeze mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The +51% (2025-05-08) and +18.7% (2025-03-13) prints came with heavy short interest. The stock also rose 17% on the 2026-11-06 sympathy day.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is itself a position. A squeeze is not priced until it happens, and with 5 days to cover the exit is not instant.
findings.independence: The earlier 70.89m / 4.2-day reading is on the same aggregator. The FINRA-based July figure of 65.1m (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/qbts/short-interest/) shows the trend. Both sources are aggregators of the same FINRA data.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-08 D-Wave signed a definitive agreement for up to $100m of CHIPS Act funding, with the Department of Commerce taking a minority equity stake (7,095,721 shares registered for resale on 9/10). The money funds R&D for 100k-qubit annealing and a 10k-qubit gate-model system plus domestic manufacturing, with milestone-based disbursement. This adds non-dilutive-to-cash funding to $546m of cash and needed no ATM in H1 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no print history on financing lines. Coverage tied the resale registration to weakness in September.
findings.why_not_priced: This is mostly priced, since it was public two months ago. What is not priced is any disbursement or milestone update, which could appear on the call. On what the money buys: R&D and manufacturing, not distress, so it is signed slightly positive.
findings.independence: The 424B7 resale prospectus 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001907982/000190798226000146/qbts-20260910.htm) is a second document on the same agreement.

findings.finding: This is the first earnings call without the long-time CFO. Markovich retired effective 2026-09-02 (announced 8/25, stock -9.5%). Greg Golkov (SVP finance) is acting CFO with no permanent hire named. A securities class action filed 2026-10-15 (class period Feb 26 - Aug 25, 2026) alleges overstated business and delivery prospects, which raises the credibility cost of any Q4 shipment slip.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The CFO announcement day moved -9.5% (2026-08-26). That was not a print day.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. The residual is how the guidance is delivered: an acting CFO under a delivery-focused lawsuit is likelier to give conservative Q4 language.
findings.independence: The lawsuit is covered by law-firm releases (https://openclassactions.com/lawsuits/d-wave-quantum-securities-class-action.php), a separate document.

outside_window.finding: Lead-plaintiff motion deadline in the securities class action (N.D. Cal.).

Actual shipment of the two Q4 annealing systems (FAU and one other) and delivery of the 17-qubit dual-rail gate-model system, both promised by year-end. The guidance on them resolves at the print (filed above); the physical events resolve later.

searched_and_found_nothing: FAU Advantage2 installation status: no FAU or D-Wave update on arrival or go-live since the January 2026 announcement
17-qubit gate-model delivery status: newest public statement is the June 2026 Investor Day and the August call ('on track')
New customer or system contracts July-Nov 2026: none with a dollar value. The Oct 1 gate-model simulator beta, Oct 28 Shionogi NEDO award and Nov 4 Stride solver upgrade 8-Ks carry no revenue figures
Permanent CFO appointment: none found through 2026-11-09
New ATM or shelf takedown since June 2026: none in EDGAR (only a 424B7 resale by the Department of Commerce)
Rigetti Q3 2026 results: reports the same morning, so not available as a read-through

baseline_tension: The negative findings agree with the +7.6-point put skew and the -16% 20-day run-up, so they are partly in the price. The +14% 5-day sympathy run-up and the crowded short (about 21% of shares out, 5 days to cover) cut the other way, which is why p_up sits at 45 rather than 35-40.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (inside the guide): Q3 revenue miss vs consensus sits inside the company's 'up modestly' guide, so it was shrunk from -1.0 to -0.5.

Lesson 7 (crowded short against a negative): with short interest about 21% of shares out at 5 days to cover, the Q4 guidance reset was shrunk from -1.5 to -1.2, thin bookings from -0.8 to -0.6, and the sympathy run-up from -0.8 to -0.6. p_up moved from 44 to 45.
Lesson 5 (proxy/inference): the Como delivery is a proxy for Q4 shipment capability whose revenue treatment is undisclosed, so it was shrunk from +0.5 to +0.4.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the CHIPS money buys R&D and manufacturing and the company has $546m of cash with no ATM, so it was kept at +0.2 rather than read as dilution.
Lesson 6 (window): the lawsuit's lead-plaintiff deadline is filed in outside_window. The acting-CFO/lawsuit credibility item was trimmed from -0.3 to -0.2 because it is largely priced.
Lesson 1 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction): kept the reaction separate. print_vs_bar stays at -15%, while expected_move is only -1.1% given positioning.
